svg.title: The rehearsal, in one database
svg.desc: The golden graph is fingerprinted with Probe and Fingerprint nodes, then the migration runs with its bug and the verdict is FAIL. The diff shows which probes failed and who lost relationships; the graph is restored from the fingerprint and the fixed dedupe runs, and the verdict is PASS. Last, the scaffolding is deleted; every step runs in one database.
